briefing: - 未见在野利用/勒索软件标记，避免误报。
- PHP高危UAF已有POC及模板，应优先修复。
- 批量公告：GitLab多枚高危，需核资产。
- 多个10.0分漏洞缺版本信息，先排查暴露面。

items.title: GitLab未认证RCE整数溢出
items.summary_zh: 未认证用户可通过特制请求触发整数溢出，在GitLab服务器执行任意代码
items.affected: GitLab(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.repro_note: 未授权入口，构造特制编译请求触发整数溢出
items.description: An issue has been discovered in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 7.0 before 18.11.13, 19.0 before 19.0.10, 19.1 before 19.1.9, 19.2 before 19.2.9, 19.3 before 19.3.6, 19.4 before 19.4.3, and 19.5 before 19.5.1 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server due to integer overflow when compiling a specially crafted regular expression.

items.title: GitLab SAML/LDAP账号接管
items.summary_zh: 已认证用户可借SAML与LDAP自动关联缺陷，无交互接管LDAP账户
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·需低权限)
items.affected: GitLab(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.repro_note: 需启用SAML与LDAP自动关联，构造邮箱查找输入
items.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 10.1 before 19.3.6, 19.4 before 19.4.3, and 19.5 before 19.5.1 that, when OmniAuth SAML and LDAP auto-linking were both enabled, an authenticated user could have taken over an existing LDAP-backed account without any interaction from the targeted user, due to improper input sanitization in the LDAP email lookup path used during OmniAuth identity linking.

items.title: GitLab OAuth缓存投毒
items.summary_zh: 未认证者可污染共享缓存的OIDC发现文档，重定向特定OAuth/OIDC流
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证·需用户交互)
items.affected: GitLab(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.repro_note: 需共享缓存，构造请求污染OAuth/OIDC发现文档URL
items.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 18.3 before 19.3.6, 19.4 before 19.4.3, and 19.5 before 19.5.1 that, under certain conditions, an unauthenticated user could have poisoned a shared cache's OAuth/OIDC discovery document to redirect certain flows to an externally controlled server, due to improper trust of user-supplied values when constructing endpoint URLs in cached discovery responses.

items.title: PHP请求内存UAF代码执行
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可通过多种请求策略触发请求内存悬垂，导致PHP进程RCE
items.action_zh: 升级PHP 8.2.35/8.3.36及以上修复版
items.repro_note: 构造请求触发全局状态指向请求内存后释放
items.description: PHP has various global state that temporarily points into request memory. In some scenarios, global state may not be correctly reset, or may be repopulated after being reset. The global state may then refer to request memory even after it has been freed. Subsequent requests may read or branch on this stale state before it is fully initialized. Multiple strategies can trigger this condition and produce remote code execution (RCE).

items.title: PHP OOM长跳转RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可通过OOM策略触发longjmp退出路径，导致PHP进程RCE
items.action_zh: 升级PHP 8.2.35/8.3.36及以上修复版
items.repro_note: 通过OOM策略触发longjmp退出，破坏请求上下文
items.description: PHP uses longjmp() for out-of-memory (OOM) errors to exit the current context and abort handling of the request. Some contexts may not properly account for this scenario and leave request memory in an uninitialized state before performing an allocation. The subsequent request cleanup procedure may read or branch on this memory. Multiple OOM strategies can consistently trigger this condition and lead to remote code execution (RCE).

items.title: Apache TS证书校验绕过
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可跨SNI虚拟主机恢复TLS会话，绕过客户端证书STRICT校验
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.repro_note: 需TLS会话恢复及verify_client STRICT，跨SNI恢复
items.description: Apache Traffic Server can resume a TLS session across SNI virtual hosts without re-verifying a client certificate required by the resumed host's verify_client STRICT policy. This issue affects Apache Traffic Server: from 8.0.0 through 8.1.11, from 9.0.0 through 9.2.15, from 10.0.0 through 10.1.4, 10.2.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 9.2.16, 10.1.5, or 10.2.1, which fix the issue.

items.title: TOTOLINK EX200栈溢出
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可向Comment参数注入超长数据，触发setStaticDhcpConfig栈溢出
items.action_zh: 升级固件；限制管理接口暴露并过滤参数
items.repro_note: 入口/cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi，Comment参数超长
items.description: A security flaw has been discovered in TOTOLINK EX200 5.2.3c.7200. This affects the function setStaticDhcpConfig of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi of the component lan.so. The manipulation of the argument Comment results in stack-based buffer overflow. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

items.title: TOTOLINK EX200无线ACL栈溢出
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可向macAddress参数注入超长数据，触发setWiFiAclAddConfig栈溢出
items.action_zh: 升级固件；限制管理接口暴露并过滤参数
items.repro_note: 入口/cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi，macAddress参数超长
items.description: A weakness has been identified in TOTOLINK EX200 5.2.3c.7200. This impacts the function setWiFiAclAddConfig of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi of the component wireless.so. This manipulation of the argument macAddress causes stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

items.title: TOTOLINK A950RG命令注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可操纵FileMd5参数，在UploadCustomModule中注入系统命令

items.description: A flaw has been found in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. Affected by this issue is the function UploadCustomModule of the file lib/cste_modules/product.so. Executing a manipulation of the argument FileMd5 can lead to command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used.

items.title: GStreamer堆溢出RCE

items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本；避免解析不可信媒体
items.repro_note: 向受影响解析器传入特制媒体文件触发堆溢出

items.title: Pillow图像解析越界写
items.summary_zh: 攻击者用特制PSD/MPO/DCX/MIC图像触发越界写，导致崩溃或代码执行
items.action_zh: 升级Pillow修复版；不解析不可信图像
items.repro_note: 构造PSD/MPO/DCX/MIC帧转换触发越界写
items.description: Pillow is a Python imaging library. Crafted PSD, MPO, DCX, or MIC frame transitions can then write wider pixels into the narrow allocation, causing native out-of-bounds writes and crashes.

items.title: Lagoon ssh服务命令注入
items.summary_zh: 拥有Lagoon账户的攻击者可经ssh服务注入命令，获取任意代码执行

items.repro_note: 需Lagoon账户，经ssh服务注入命令执行
items.description: Versions prior to 2.33.1 have a vulnerability in the `ssh` service in Lagoon core that would allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code which could lead to, among other things, elevated administrative permissions. It is mitigated by the fact that an attacker must have a Lagoon user account.

items.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in WPdreams Ajax Search Lite ajax-search-lite allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects Ajax Search Lite: from n/a through 4.14.6.

items.title: ATS 响应走私致缓存投毒
items.title_zh: ATS 响应走私致缓存投毒
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可构造畸形302响应，利用分块编码绕过解析拒绝，导致缓存投毒与分帧失步。
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 关注厂商修复版本，临时严格校验302响应分帧
items.repro_note: 构造畸形302响应并带Transfer-Encoding分块，观察缓存存储与前后端解析差异
items.impact_scope: 缓存代理/边界设备，可污染共享缓存
items.description: Apache Traffic Server forwarded a malformed 302 response that should have been rejected as a parse error, because the Transfer-Encoding: chunked carve-out bypassed the rejection path. A response that two peers can read differently is then stored and served, allowing cache poisoning and response-framing desync.

items.title: ATS HEAD 请求走私
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者用带CL/TE的HEAD请求触发分帧歧义，实施请求走私。
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.repro_note: 向缓存代理发送含CL/TE的HEAD请求，对比前后端分帧结果
items.impact_scope: 边界缓存代理，可致走私与缓存污染
items.description: Apache Traffic Server allows request smuggling via HEAD requests that carry Content-Length or Transfer-Encoding. This issue affects Apache Traffic Server: from 8.0.0 through 8.1.11, from 9.0.0 through 9.2.15, from 10.0.0 through 10.1.4, 10.2.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 9.2.16, 10.1.5, or 10.2.1, which fix the issue.

items.title: Apache 多角色令牌校验绕过
items.title_zh: Apache 多角色令牌校验绕过
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者伪造未签名令牌并声明任意角色，访问管理REST或WebSocket接口。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本，禁用匿名角色回退并校验令牌签名
items.repro_note: 向管理REST/WS发送含任意角色的未签名令牌，需启用匿名角色回退
items.description: As a result, in deployments that use MultiRolesTokenAuthorizationProvider together with a non-empty anonymousUserRole and that permit this fallback, an unauthenticated client can send an HTTP request, for example to the admin REST API or the WebSocket API, with a forged or unsigned token that lists arbitrary roles, and be authorized with those roles.

items.title: TokenGuard 非字符串凭证认证绕过
items.title_zh: TokenGuard 非字符串凭证认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者在MySQL/MariaDB配置下提交非字符串凭证，匹配到其他用户并接管账户。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级至 12.68.0/13.29.0，严格校验凭证类型
items.repro_note: 向TokenGuard路由发数组凭证，在MySQL/MariaDB下观察用户匹配
items.impact_scope: Web认证接口，可致账户接管
items.description: Laravel is a web application framework. Prior to 12.68.0 and 13.29.0, TokenGuard configured as a standard token-based API guard does not reject a crafted non-string credential. Under affected MySQL or MariaDB configurations, the authentication lookup can match an unintended existing user, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication and take over an account on routes protected by TokenGuard. This issue is fixed in versions 12.68.0 and 13.29.0.

items.title: Acronis ACI 授权检查不当
items.title_zh: Acronis ACI 授权检查不当
items.summary_zh: 攻击者利用错误授权检查读取敏感信息并篡改ACI资源，具体入口待公告。
items.repro_note: 访问ACI管理接口验证越权读取/修改；需有效账户或特定接口
items.impact_scope: 虚拟化管理面，高价值数据
items.description: Sensitive information disclosure and manipulation due to improper authorization checks. The following products are affected: Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) before build 6.0.1-112, Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) before build 6.1.1-64, Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) before build 6.2.1-71.

items.title: Tunnel路由碰撞绕过中间件鉴权
items.title_zh: Tunnel路由碰撞绕过中间件鉴权
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者构造与tunnel路径冲突的路由请求，绕过仅依赖中间件的授权访问受保护接口。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本，避免tunnelRoute与业务路由冲突并加服务端授权
items.repro_note: 访问与tunnel路径冲突的根动态路由，需启用tunnelRoute且仅中间件鉴权
items.impact_scope: Web应用认证边界，配置相关
items.description: When an application route directly collides with the tunnel path or a root dynamic segment resolves under it, an unauthenticated request can reach that route without middleware authorization. Exploitation requires tunnelRoute, a webpack build, a colliding route, and middleware being the only authorization control.

items.repro_note: 需确认具体Cisco产品与触发接口；当前仅知越界写入类别
items.impact_scope: 网络设备，可能影响边界或内网
items.description: As part of Cisco's ongoing commitment to proactive security and product quality, the Cisco owned Open Source Snort 3 Software engineering team has conducted a comprehensive internal security review. This review resulted in software hardening releases that address multiple internally discovered vulnerabilities. The vulnerabilities tracked by CVE-2026-20043 are related to issues concerning out-of-bounds writes that are grouped under the Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) Base CWE-787.

items.title: ATS tsmemcache 未授权读写
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者访问实验性tsmemcache插件，读取、写入或删除共享代理缓存。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)

items.action_zh: 升级到 9.2.16/10.1.5/10.2.1，禁用tsmemcache

This issue affects Apache Traffic Server: from 8.0.0 through 8.1.11, from 9.0.0 through 9.2.15, from 10.0.0 through 10.1.4, 10.2.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 9.2.16, 10.1.5, or 10.2.1, which fix the issue.
